support: r<2, |z|<2; smooth zero extension of u and p
representation: New alternative, not Eq45 default: psi=r^2 F(r^2,z,t), u_theta=r B; bumped tensor Legendre spatial factors and Chebyshev time factors. F odd in z; B,p even in z. Spatial velocity columns energy-orthonormalized. No old coefficient/bound changes.
method: bounded L-BFGS-B, float64 coefficient gradients, full three-component residual plus core/energy feasibility
norms: max Euclidean norm; sqrt(64*mean(|R|^2)) on uniform box samples
